planned_claim: ControllerV3 allocates a variable evidence budget across questions
allowed_wording: The rule policy produces question-dependent evidence budgets.

planned_claim: ControllerV3 and BM25 top-7 have close test retrieval point estimates at similar estimated cost
allowed_wording: Point estimates are close at similar mean cost.

planned_claim: Paired bootstrap intervals show no clear ControllerV3--top-7 retrieval difference
allowed_wording: The interval does not show a clear sampled difference.
prohibited_wording: The two methods are statistically equivalent.

planned_claim: Section expansion improves the full controller relative to the no-section ablation but uses more evidence
allowed_wording: The full variant improves coverage over its lower-budget ablation at an additional cost.
prohibited_wording: Section targeting is free or unconditionally more efficient.

planned_claim: Matched-budget controls do not show a clear independent aggregate benefit from section targeting
allowed_wording: The apparent ablation gain is largely attributable to the larger evidence budget.

planned_claim: Frozen generation results show nearly identical ControllerV3 and top-7 F1 point estimates
allowed_wording: No clear sampled F1 difference is observed.
prohibited_wording: The methods are equivalent or ControllerV3 is superior.

planned_claim: Prompt construction changes the cost actually observed by the generator
allowed_wording: Retrieved-unit cost and actual prompt-token cost are distinct quantities.
prohibited_wording: Estimated retrieval tokens equal model tokenizer tokens.

planned_claim: QASPER supports evaluation of both answers and annotated evidence
allowed_wording: Use only after exact source verification.
prohibited_wording: Do not rely on memory or the interim bibliography alone.

planned_claim: Longer contexts may be used unevenly depending on evidence position
allowed_wording: State the experimental scope of the cited study.

planned_claim: The final method differs materially from the interim dynamic-stopping proposal
allowed_wording: The final scope was narrowed to a deterministic rule policy whose Stop action follows configured branches.
prohibited_wording: A hidden sufficiency model or iterative search loop was implemented.
